lessons.text: Never use appeal to ignorance (Treating the absence of disproof as proof (or the reverse)). It cost you against Averroes (Ibn Rushd).
Never use appeal to emotion (Substituting feeling for reasoning). It cost you against Averroes (Ibn Rushd).
Never use no true scotsman (Redefining a category on the fly to exclude a damaging counterexample). It cost you against Averroes (Ibn Rushd).

Prepare an answer before you assert: Averroes (Ibn Rushd) broke through with "However, your premise assumes what it needs to prove, and the data shows otherwise. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the pre…" (Clean argument. structure=0.50, evidence=1.00).

Prepare an answer before you assert: Averroes (Ibn Rushd) broke through with "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. Because homework builds lasting mastery, the documented cases show the be…" (Clean argument. structure=0.50, evidence=1.00).

Borrow this pattern from Averroes (Ibn Rushd): "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. Because homework builds lasting mastery, the documented cases show the be…" — it answered the opponent directly, it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.

Your weakest move against Averroes (Ibn Rushd) was "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. When the measured results are compared across studies, then the pattern i…" (soundness 0.20). State its premises and evidence before you use it again.
